verdict.line: You lose if you trade into a full wave with Grasp on cooldown; you win if you wait out Death's Grasp and step in only after your Adaptive Defenses shield is up.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate) hits harder the fewer targets it clips, so any extended 1v1 in a cleared lane rewards him directly, and his E (Death's Grasp) threatens to pull you into that trade whenever it's up. Camille has no innate CC before E (Hookshot) connects, so the 47.9% win rate over 140 games reflects a lane where she has to survive on shield timing and wave control rather than out-trade him raw.

theirWindow.when: Death's Grasp is up and you're near minions
theirWindow.what: He can pull you into range and follow with Q (Obliterate), which deals its highest damage to a single target — back off wave until it's spent.

yourWindow.when: Right after you land a basic attack on him
yourWindow.what: Adaptive Defenses grants a shield against his damage type — since Morde is all magic damage, this is your one-sided trade window per the standard read on this matchup, so extend the fight now, not before.

start.why: Highest-performing start in the data (45.8% WR, 118 games, 67.1% pick) — the extra sustain and damage help you survive Obliterate poke while you wait for auto-trade windows.

boots.why: 53.2% WR over 109 games and 72.7% pick — magic resist directly answers Morde's all-magic kit, and the tenacity shortens how long Death's Grasp pins you in his kill range.

core.why: First item on the top-performing path (52.3% WR, 44 games); the burst and move speed are what flip you from 'them' to 'you' on the power curve at 9-13.
Second in the same 52.3% WR path — sustain and cleave help you fight through his shield stacking on Indestructible.
Completes the 53% pick-rate core — damage mitigation over time matters against a champion whose Q punishes prolonged single-target exchanges.

situational.when: he's landing his passive damage aura (Darkness Rise) consistently and you need to survive his burst windows
the game goes long and you need lower cooldowns to keep pressuring him off cooldown windows

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.8% WR at 30.4% pick — sustain through the early trades this lane forces on you, since you're waiting out his cooldowns rather than freely dueling.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (48.7%) and by far the most-picked combo (66.1%) — Ignite punishes him for over-committing Q (Obliterate) or Death's Grasp into you, while Flash covers you against the pull threat itself.

playing.title: Trade only after landing an auto
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses shields you against his damage type once you've hit him. Since he's all magic, that's your genuine one-sided window — don't initiate before it's up.

playing.title: Track Death's Grasp, not just Q
playing.detail: He can pull you from 700 range into full trading distance. If it's on cooldown, you can safely hold minion-adjacent positions; if it's up, give yourself room to walk out.

playing.title: Don't fight into a fresh wave
playing.detail: Obliterate deals increased damage the fewer targets it hits, so an isolated 1v1 in a cleared lane favors him — keep minions between you when trading.

playing.title: Watch his passive stacks
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after he lands 3 attacks or spells on champions or monsters, granting a damage aura and move speed. If he's been farming near you with Q, back off before he hits that third proc mid-trade.

playing.title: Save Hookshot for a real window
playing.detail: E (Hookshot) needs a wall and knocks up on landing — commit it only once his Death's Grasp and Indestructible shield charge are already spent, not as an opener.

playing.title: Use Ultimatum to isolate, not to all-in blind
playing.detail: R anchors him to you and adds magic damage on your autos, but his own R can steal your stats and flip a straight duel — pull him away from allies or objectives rather than forcing a 1v1 you don't need.

playing.title: Look for the fight after Trinity Force
playing.detail: Your power curve turns in your favor once Trinity Force completes (levels 9-13) — that's when your mobility and burst finally outpace his sustain, so start looking for skirmishes off wave.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning — trade timing, shield windows, and cooldown reads — is my own analysis, not OP.GG's.
